about.what: Video redaction and allow-list benchmark on the team's own clips (2 dashcam plate clips, 3 phone face clips), Engine max_privacy mode (face 0.06, plate 0.05, 1280 px, ByteTrack, render padding 0.1), three detectors.
about.full_0.9 / full_0.7: a labelled box counts as fully blurred when at least 90% / 70% of it is covered by the padded blur boxes
about.counts: n = labelled boxes (one per object per frame). full/partly/missed = coverage >= bar / between / zero. detected = an Engine detection (not interpolated) with IoU >= 0.5. Owner tracks are excluded from the label groups and counted only in allow: owner_hit = owner box under 10% blurred; stranger_hit = stranger box not fully blurred; stranger_kept_by_allow_list = stranger box not fully blurred and under a box the Engine kept as the owner (IoU >= 0.3). <label>/runs = lengths in frames of consecutive not-fully-blurred frames per labelled stranger track.
about.clips: video = resolution/fps/frames; keyframes = boxes a person placed; filled_in_boxes = boxes CVAT interpolated between them

wider_occlusion.note: Detection bench (infra/bench, WIDER val faces), current model, face threshold 0.06, padding 0.1; hidden = >= 70% covered

after_fixes_and_tools.about: Engine after removing the corner filter and keeping unconfirmed detections (current model), and two open-source tools run frame by frame on the same frames. padding = blur box growth each side as each tool ships it (deface 1.3x mask = 0.15, EgoBlur scale 1.0 = 0). EgoBlur has no allow list: it blurs owners too (owner frames are excluded from its stranger numbers like everyone else's).

dashcam_and_allow_list_fixes._about: Engine as shipped on 2026-11-20 (widest-crop plate OCR, track split after gaps > 167 ms), one run per detector and clip. Per label class and group: n labelled boxes, full (>= --full covered: 0.9 plates, 0.7 faces), partly, missed, detected (IoU >= 0.5). allow: owner/stranger frames, owner_hit = owner left visible, stranger_hit = stranger not fully blurred, stranger_kept_by_allow_list. Runs (lists of leak lengths) are left out.

face_allow_list_pool_and_label_fix._about: 2026-11-26. Dashcam models of both modes (maxnew = yolo26s-1280-e5-dashcam, fastnew = yolo26n-1280-e5-dashcam). -split = before the face track handling and the shared crop pool, -t10 = now. Plate clips scored with the fixed labels (11 owner pieces mislabelled as unknown merged or deleted); face clip labels unchanged. Plates fully blurred at 0.9, faces at 0.7.
